card.name: Moving liquid into a syringe or bag
card.fires_on: The word 'into' (also 'from', 'be', 'Aspir-ate') right after a verb of moving liquid, such as transfer, withdraw or dispense, in preparation instructions.

modes.label: Transfer into container
modes.description: 'into' after transfer, withdrawn or dispense, before a syringe, bag or bottle.
modes.example: Transfer all of the mixed product<< into>> Syringe B by depressing the Syringe

card.plain: It lights up on the small word 'into' in steps that tell you to move a liquid into a syringe or bag.
